name: blackthorn-obm
description: Blackthorn team plugin with specialized OBM workflows. Includes skills for day prep, Fathom research, email templates, product support, and memory management — plus OBM-specific tools for customer dossiers, COM updates, kickoff decks, and flagged syncs. Works for any Blackthorn team member; OBM features activate based on your department. Run the begin skill to set up your workspace.
